articles.title: Matthews leads Three Stars of the Week, had nine points in three games
Jake Oettinger named NHL's Second Star of the Week
Duchene has surgery for core injury, out three months for Stars
He’s back: Seguin’s first goal a good reminder of what could lie ahead
Game Day Guide: Avalanche vs Stars

away.summary: The Stars are 2-2-1 and will start Jake Oettinger in net. They are without Matt Duchene due to core injury surgery (out three months). Tyler Seguin is returning to the lineup after an ACL injury layoff and scored in the last game vs. Pittsburgh.

home.summary: The Avalanche are 3-2-0 coming off a 6-3 loss to Toronto. Nathan MacKinnon leads the team in goals and points. No lineup or goalie information for this game is provided in the articles.
